name: Sword Swing
description: A single overhead-to-diagonal sword swing with the right arm: the blade is raised behind the shoulder, driven down across the body, and followed through before the guard returns.
poses: ready: right arm raised, blade behind the shoulder, weight on the back foot
drive: right arm swinging forward, body turning into the cut
follow through: blade across the body, hips and shoulders rotated
recover: arm returning to guard, body squared again
